title: Section 1 — Description and history
description: Signature Arcade is a mirror of the games kind of website: a website that lets visitors play games in the browser, with nothing to download and nothing to install. The kind grew out of single games played on one machine, then games shared over the network, then whole catalogs of small games that load in the browser and start at once. This mirror follows that same shape — a catalog of games, a game that starts on the page, and a score — rebuilt with Signature branding and the network's own data.

title: Section 3 — Science proof
description: The science behind this mirror is the science of play and feedback. A game is a loop: the player acts, the game answers, and the player acts again with new information. The guessing game is the smallest honest form of that loop — each answer narrows the range of numbers the secret can be, so a careful player finds it in a few tries by halving the range each time.

title: Section 4 — Relevant data
description: The list below is the mirror's own sample catalog: 10 Signature-made games, made in the network for this mirror. They are not games from outside the network.

title: Section 5 — Spec / patent + 3D-print version
description: Spec. The Signature spec for this mirror is a draft specification for a games mirror over a fixed, network-owned catalog: the game record format (name, kind, short rules), the seeded secret-number rule and the score rule from Section 2, and the no-tracking, no-account, no-server design. The spec is a draft — ready to file, not filed, not a granted patent. It is part of the mirror program's spec pack.

title: Section 6 — Demonstration programs / working prototypes
description: The demonstration program on the main page is the number-guessing game. Type a whole number from 1 to 100, press the button, and the mirror answers higher, lower, or correct, and keeps count of your tries. When you guess right, it shows your score by the rule in Section 2.

title: Section 7 — Two AIs
description: The website AI of this mirror: it discusses the mirror, helps you pick a game from the sample catalog, explains any game's rules and its score, and routes detailed questions to the website or database AI that owns the subject. It is networked to the whole network, explains itself in great detail when asked, and speaks in natural sentences.

title: Section 8 — USE section — use, download, copy
description: Use it: use the guessing game at the top of this page. Type a whole number, press the button, and follow the higher and lower answers until you find the secret number. The game runs in your browser, on the rule in the page.

title: Section 9 — Sources, codes, and network
description: Sources. The mirror's sample catalog comes from the network's own data: 10 Signature-made games made in the network for this mirror, listed in Section 4. The secret-number rule and the score rule are the mirror's own rules, stated in full in Section 2. The science in Section 3 is general knowledge about play and feedback, described here in general terms; no outside source is quoted as the mirror's own method.

title: 2. The AI version of the browser games
description: Signature Arcade AI — an AI version of the games arcade itself: it plays the guessing game with you in conversation, keeps your tries and your score, and talks through the sample catalog game by game. Its spec is the spec in Section 5.

title: The demonstration — Guess the secret number (1 to 100)
description: The mirror picks its secret number from a fixed seed, so the same seed always gives the same secret — the rule is in Section 2. Each guess tells you higher or lower. Your score is 100 minus 10 for each guess after the first, down to 0.
